proposition: The date of the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk is given by MK in slightly different ways on different pages: 'completed in 829/1426' (pdf p.158), 'most probably written in 829/1426' (p.159), 'in or before 829/1426' (p.328) and 'before 829/1426' (p.173); all place completion at or before 829/1426.

mediation.note: An internal variation in MK's own dating
